arxiv-2012-11179.title: Electronic correlations and magnetic interactions in infinite-layer NdNiO 2
arxiv-2012-11179.creator: Vamshi M. Katukuri, Nikolay A. Bogdanov, Oskar Weser, Jeroen van den Brink, Ali Alavi
arxiv-2012-11179.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Vamshi M. Katukuri, Nikolay A. Bogdanov, Oskar Weser, Jeroen van den Brink, Ali Alavi. The large antiferromagnetic exchange coupling in the parent high- T c T_{\rm c} cuprate superconductors is believed to play a crucial role in pairing the superconducting carriers. The recent observation of superconductivity in hole-doped infinite-layer (IL-) NdNiO 2 brings to the fore the relevance of magnetic coupling in high-T c superconductors, particularly because no magnetic ordering is observed in the undoped IL-NdNiO 2 unlike in parent copper oxides.

arxiv-2108-13876.title: One-shot domain adaptation for semantic face editing of real world images using StyleALAE
arxiv-2108-13876.creator: Ravi Kiran Reddy*, Kumar Shubham*, Gopalakrishnan Venkatesh, Sriram Gandikota, Sarthak Khoche, Dinesh Babu Jayagopi, Gopalakrishnan Srinivasaraghavan
arxiv-2108-13876.description: Abstract Semantic face editing of real world facial images is an important application of generative models. Recently, multiple works have explored possible techniques to generate such modifications using the latent structure of pre-trained GAN models. However, such approaches often require training an encoder network and that is typically a time-consuming and resource intensive process.

arxiv-2204-05740.title: Adaptive cross approximation for Tikhonov regularization in general form
arxiv-2204-05740.creator: T. Mach, L. Reichel, M. Van Barel
arxiv-2204-05740.description: Abstract Many problems in Science and Engineering give rise to linear integral equations of the first kind with a smooth kernel. Discretization of the integral operator yields a matrix, whose singular values cluster at the origin. We describe the approximation of such matrices by adaptive cross approximation, which avoids forming the entire matrix.

arxiv-2209-00012.title: Luck of the Irish? A companion of the Cloverleaf connected by a bridge of molecular gas 2022 Luck of the Irish? A companion of the Cloverleaf connected by a bridge of molecular gas – References
arxiv-2209-00012.creator: H. R. Stacey, F. Arrigoni Battaia
arxiv-2209-00012.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by H. R. Stacey, F. Arrigoni Battaia. We present deep observations of CO (3–2) from the Cloverleaf lensed quasar-starburst at z = 2.56 z=2.56 . We discover a 4–5 times less massive companion at a projected distance of 33 kpc from the Cloverleaf host galaxy. The galaxies are connected by a bridge of CO emission, indicating that they are interacting and that the companion is being stripped by the Cloverleaf.

arxiv-2303-14182.title: The effect of the Austrian-German bidding zone split on unplanned cross-border flows
arxiv-2303-14182.creator: Theresa Graefe
arxiv-2303-14182.description: Abstract In 2013, TSOs from the Central European Region complained to the Agency for the Cooperation of Energy Regulators because of increasing unplanned flows that were presumed to be caused by a joint German-Austrian bidding zone in the European electricity market.

Source code and data: https://gi
arxiv-2312-08949.creator: Frank Sippel, Jürgen Seiler, André Kaup
arxiv-2312-08949.description: Abstract Exploiting the infrared area of the spectrum for classification problems is getting increasingly popular, because many materials have characteristic absorption bands in this area. However, sensors in the short wave infrared (SWIR) area and even higher wavelengths have a very low spatial resolution in comparison to classical cameras that operate in the visible wavelength area.

arxiv-2404-08950.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning based Online Scheduling Policy for Deep Neural Network Multi-Tenant Multi-Accelerator Systems Conference: 61st ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference; June 23–27, 2024; San Francisco, CA, USA 61st ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC ’24), June 23–27, 2024, San Franc
arxiv-2404-08950.creator: Francesco G. Blanco, Enrico Russo, Maurizio Palesi, Davide Patti, Giuseppe Ascia, Vincenzo Catania
arxiv-2404-08950.description: Abstract . Currently, there is a growing trend of outsourcing the execution of DNNs to cloud services. For service providers, managing multi-tenancy and ensuring high-quality service delivery, particularly in meeting stringent execution time constraints, assumes paramount importance, all while endeavoring to maintain cost-effectiveness. In this context, the utilization of heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems becomes increasingly relevant.

arxiv-2405-02427.title: On the thermodynamics of two-level Fermi and Bose nanosystems
arxiv-2405-02427.creator: Yu.M. Poluektov, A.A. Soroka
arxiv-2405-02427.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yu.M. Poluektov, A.A. Soroka. Equations are obtained for the quantum distribution functions over discrete states in systems of non-interacting fermions and bosons with an arbitrary, including small, number of particles. The case of systems with two levels is considered in detail. The temperature dependences of entropy, heat capacities and pressure in two-level Fermi and Bose systems are calculated for various multiplicities of degeneracy of levels.

arxiv-2502-13579.title: Finite-rate quench in disordered Chern and Z 2 Z_{2} topological insulators
arxiv-2502-13579.creator: Sheng-Nan Du, Zhao Liu
arxiv-2502-13579.description: Abstract We study the quantum quench of a finite rate across topological quantum transitions in two-dimensional Chern and Z 2 Z_{2} topological insulators. We choose the representative Haldane model and the Kane-Mele model to investigate the behavior of excitation density generated by the quench and the impact of disorder on it.

arxiv-2504-03213.title: Octaquarks in a simple chromomagnetic model
arxiv-2504-03213.creator: Aaron Park
arxiv-2504-03213.description: Abstract In this work, we study the octaquark, which is composed of two baryons and one meson using a simple chromomagnetic model. First, we construct the wave function of the octaquark satisfying the Pauli exclusion principle in the flavor SU(3) breaking case.

arxiv-2506-11483.title: Capsule: Efficient Player Isolation for Datacenters
arxiv-2506-11483.creator: Zhouheng Du, Nima Davari, Li Li, Nodir Kodirov
arxiv-2506-11483.description: Abstract . Cloud gaming is increasingly popular. A challenge for cloud provider is to keep datacenter utilization high: a non-trivial task due to application variety. These applications come in different shapes and sizes. So do cloud datacenter resources, e.g., CPUs, GPUs, NPUs. Part of the challenge stems from game engines being predominantly designed to run only one player.

arxiv-2510-16955.title: On the use of the Derivative Approximation for Likelihoods for Gravitational Wave Inference
arxiv-2510-16955.creator: Miguel Quartin
arxiv-2510-16955.description: Abstract Posterior inference on the more than a dozen parameters governing a gravitational wave (GW) event is challenging. A typical MCMC analysis can take around 100 100 CPU hours, and next generation GW observatories will detect many thousands of events.

pmc-11311000.title: Comparative Analysis of Morphometric, Densitometric, and Mechanical Properties of Skeletal Locomotor Elements in Three Duck Species (Anatidae: Anatinae)
pmc-11311000.creator: Cezary Osiak-Wicha, Ewa Tomaszewska, Siemowit Muszyński, Marian Flis, Michał Świetlicki, Marcin B Arciszewski, Giuseppe Maiorano
pmc-11311000.description: Simple SummaryThis study aims to investigate the skeletal adaptations of three duck species: the Mallard, Tufted Duck, and Green-Winged Teal. Ducks play a critical role in wetland ecosystems by aiding in seed dispersal and nutrient cycling. To understand how their skeletal structures support different survival strategies and modes of locomotion, this research focuses on the tibiotarsus and humerus bones.

pmc-12413079.title: Epidemiological, temporal, and geographic trends of leptospirosis in the United States, 2014–2020
pmc-12413079.creator: Christine Atherstone, Renee Galloway, Ilana Schafer, Aileen Artus, Melissa Marzan Rodriguez, Kyle Ryff, Abigail Medina Rivera, Sally Slavinski, Marc Paladini, Sarah K. Kemble, Janet M. Berreman, Grayson Kallas, Rita Traxler, Grishma Kharod, Marta Guerra, Robyn A. Stoddard, Hannah Moore, William A. B
pmc-12413079.description: BackgroundLeptospirosis, caused by pathogenic Leptospira spp., is one of the most widespread zoonotic diseases globally. In 2014, leptospirosis was reinstated as a nationally notifiable condition due to evidence of increasing incidence and public health importance. We describe the epidemiological, temporal, and geographic trends of leptospirosis in the United States since reinstatement.

pmc-12629713.title: Li-Ginseng powder protects against alcohol-induced liver injury by promoting acetaldehyde clearance and cellular homeostasis
pmc-12629713.creator: Ya-Ni Wang, De-Yu Wang, Yu-Hui Li, Cheng-Yan He, Xu-Ming Li, Yang Li, Ying-Hua Jin
pmc-12629713.description: BackgroundChronic and excessive alcohol consumption is a primary driver of alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD), a global health challenge with limited treatment options. Panax ginseng Meyer exhibits various pharmacological activities, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. However, its efficacy in preventing alcohol-induced liver injury remains limited, necessitating further optimization and investigation.

pmc-13551299.description: There is scarcity of evidence on the changes over time of adherence to oral HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) among female sex workers. Therefore, we assessed the changes of adherence to PrEP over 12 months and influencing factors for suboptimal adherence and explored strategies to optimize adherence to oral PrEP among female sex workers in Tanzania.

pmc-13601893.creator: Drew H. Abney, Stephen J. Sheinkopf, Samantha G. Mitsven, Ronald Seifer, Barry M. Lester, Ed Z. Tronick, Daniel S. Messinger
pmc-13601893.description: The ability of human infants to dynamically adapt their physiological states to changing social demands is critical for the development of emotion regulation. We investigated infant parasympathetic dynamics related to emotion regulation—changes in respiratory sinus arrhythmia (RSA)—using a large sample of 974 at-risk infant–mother dyads (infant age: 4 months).

uslaw-usc-t11-s326.title: 11 U.S.C. § 326 — Limitation on compensation of trustee
uslaw-usc-t11-s326.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s326.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 3 (Case Administration); Subchapter II (Officers). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In a case under chapter 7 or 11, other than a case under subchapter V of chapter 11, the court may allow reasonable compensation under section 330 of this title of the trustee for the trustee’s services, payable after the trustee renders such.

uslaw-usc-t42-s1382i.creator: United States Congress

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authorization of appropriations for pilot program There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to establish and carry out a 3-year Federal-State pilot.
